scenarios.name: Open a second window for a part and returns to the first

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/revolve/revolve-profile.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited
the user chooses New in the View tab's Windows group
a second window for the same part becomes active
the new window has a numbered document tab
the application title identifies the second window number
the part's model browser is displayed
the user opens the Switch menu on the View tab
the original part window is listed with a different window number
the user selects the original part window
the original sketch viewport is displayed
the original numbered document tab is active
